policy.arms: Use the original stereo mean, the balance-routed output, the higher score across either anonymous output, or the lower score when both outputs score. Score both without speaker labels. Each output must pass the speech check and be unclipped.
policy.case_roles: Surrey uses genuine views only to set the points. BBC and the three Huddersfield layouts are reported separately. The exact audio was used in prior studies.
policy.locations: A useful range covers half the edited time and reaches at least 0.30 temporal IoU. Preserve all original findings in the additive comparison. A source group flags when any ordinary version flags. Report all missed and unassessed files.
policy.review: For each layout, compare extra and lost ranges, added ordinary groups, background-only flags, and equal-false-group budgets. No variant serves or enters confidence on this reused panel.
policy.windows: Use the original two-second grid. Each fixed point is the highest eligible genuine Surrey file response, with strict excess. Prefer the earlier interval at a tie.
